[[File:Blumfruit_harvest.png|thumb|right|250px|Ewoks harvesting blumfruits on Endor]]
'''Blumfruit''' was a fruit used in the preparation of [[blumfruit muffin]]s, such as were popular at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. A delicacy to the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], this large, red, egg-shaped berry grew of the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. It was also used in the creation of [[blumfruit cooler]]s, and could be added to a contemporary dessert known as [[Bama Bar|Bama bar]]s. As a child, [[Vima Sunrider]] drank [[Blumfruit juice/Legends|juice]] made from blumfruits, which she tended to get all over her face and clothing.
